# List

Figma: [07g. List](https://www.figma.com/design/a7Z956YZy9n6f9uz5DK16Y?node-id=69-948) · Family: 07 Cards & Lists · Status: stable · Version 2.0.0 · Updated 2026-01-01

The content-list system: several display styles - Plain, Divided, Inset (grouped card), Bulleted, Numbered and Description (key-value) - plus single/multi Selection. Every style composes the shared Content atom. Researched from Material 3, Apple HIG, IBM Carbon and Polaris.

### List

Read-only content list in six display styles: Plain, Divided, Inset, Bulleted, Numbered and Description (key-value with total). For presenting information, not for navigation or choice.

Level: organism · Contains: List / TextItem, List / DescriptionRow

Use when:
- Feature or benefit bullets on deal or onboarding pages (Style=Bulleted)
- Ordered how-to steps (Style=Numbered)
- Amount breakdowns with a total such as total invested, profit, net value (Style=Description)
- Static text lists (Plain / Divided / Inset)

Don't use when:
- Rows that navigate or toggle: use ActionList with ListItem
- Choosing options: use SelectionList
- Many comparable records: use a Table
- Hidden optional detail: use Accordion

Accessibility: ul/ol semantics for bulleted/numbered, dl for Description; Western digits in markers and values.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Style | `style` | variant | Plain, Divided, Inset, Bulleted, Numbered, Description | Plain |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

### List / TextItem

A List text row: optional Bullet or Number marker plus the Content atom.

Level: molecule · Contains: Content · Part of: List

Use when:
- Rows of List in Plain, Divided, Inset, Bulleted or Numbered styles

Don't use when:
- Key-value rows: use List / DescriptionRow
- Interactive rows: use ListItem

Accessibility: Use native list markers so counts are announced.

### List / DescriptionRow

Key-value row of a Description list: term and value, with a Total emphasis for the bottom line.

Level: molecule · Part of: List

Use when:
- Breakdown rows in List Style=Description; Emphasis=Total for net value

Don't use when:
- Single attribute pairs elsewhere: use KeyValue
- Table data: use Table / Cell

Accessibility: dt/dd pairing; currency after the amount.

### SelectRow

Selectable row with a radio or checkbox, title and description; selected state adds a brand border and tint.

Level: molecule · Contains: Content, Radio Indicator, Checkbox Indicator · Part of: SelectionList

Use when:
- Rows inside SelectionList
- Choosing a payment method or plan (Type=Radio)
- Multi-choice filters or channels (Type=Checkbox)

Don't use when:
- Rows that navigate or toggle a setting: use ListItem
- Bare checkbox or radio with a label: use Checkbox or Radio

Accessibility: Whole row is the radio/checkbox label; checked state exposed natively; never colour alone.

### SelectionList

List for choosing among options: SelectRows in Single (radio, exactly one) or Multi (checkbox, any number) mode with group header and footer.

Level: organism · Contains: SelectRow

Use when:
- Select payment method or bank account (Mode=Single)
- Filter by asset type or notification channels (Mode=Multi)
- Picking a plan with a sensible default preselected

Don't use when:
- Navigation or settings rows: use ActionList
- Single on/off: use Switch
- Long option lists in a form field: use Select or Combobox Field
- Compact 2 to 5 short options: use SegmentedControl_2..5

Accessibility: Single = radiogroup, Multi = group of checkboxes, both labelled by the header; never mix radio and checkbox rows.

| Property in Figma | Code name | Type | Values | Default |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Has header | `hasHeader` | boolean |  | true |
| Has footer | `hasFooter` | boolean |  | true |
| Mode | `mode` | variant | Single, Multi | Single |
| Direction | `direction` | variant | LTR, RTL | LTR |

## Guide from the doc page

### Overview

A selection list is for choosing, not navigating. Each row carries a radio or checkbox and a clear selected state (brand border + tint). Single mode enforces one choice (radio); Multi mode allows several (checkbox). If a row should take the user somewhere or toggle a setting, that is ActionList / ListItem - not this.

### Composition

SelectRow composes the Radio / Checkbox Indicator with the ListItem / Content atom (title + description). SelectionList stacks SelectRows with a group header and footer.

SelectRow (selected)

SelectionList (single)

### Display styles

Six ways to present a content list, mapped from the major systems: Plain & Divided (Apple plain), Inset (Apple inset-grouped), Bulleted & Numbered (Carbon/Polaris), and Description (Polaris/Carbon key-value). Every row is a List / TextItem or List / DescriptionRow molecule - which in turn compose the Content atom.

Plain

Divided

Inset (grouped)

### Modes - Single & Multi

Single = radio buttons, exactly one selected. Multi = checkboxes, any number selected.

Single (radio)

Multi (checkbox)

### SelectRow states

Unselected, Selected (brand border + tint + filled control), and Disabled - for both radio and checkbox rows.

Radio · Unselected

Radio · Selected

Checkbox · Selected

Disabled

### Direction - LTR & RTL

Mirrors fully: the control moves to the trailing edge, content right-aligns, and Arabic reads right-to-left.

LTR

RTL

### Examples & patterns

Single for mutually-exclusive choices (payment method), Multi for independent ones (filters) - rows can carry leading icons and trailing values.

SELECT PAYMENT METHOD

One method is charged at checkout.

FILTER BY ASSET TYPE

Showing 2 of 3 asset types.

### Code examples

Flutter - Single (radio) and Multi (checkbox).

```dart
SafqahSelectionList.single(
  header: 'CHOOSE A PLAN',
  value: selectedPlan,
  onChanged: (p) => setState(() => selectedPlan = p),
  options: [
    SelectOption(value: 'premium', title: 'Premium', description: 'Best for active investors'),
    SelectOption(value: 'standard', title: 'Standard', description: 'For getting started'),
  ],
)
```

```dart
SafqahSelectionList.multi(
  header: 'NOTIFY ME VIA',
  values: channels,
  onChanged: (set) => setState(() => channels = set),
  options: [
    SelectOption(value: 'email', title: 'Email', description: 'Weekly summary'),
    SelectOption(value: 'push', title: 'Push', description: 'Real-time updates'),
  ],
)
```

### Usage - Do & Don’t

Do

Use Single (radio) for mutually-exclusive choices - a plan, a payment method - with a sensible default preselected.

Don’t

Don’t use a selection list to navigate or toggle a setting - that’s ActionList / ListItem (a row that goes somewhere or flips a Switch).

Do

Use Multi (checkbox) only when several options can be true at once - channels, filters, permissions.

Don’t

Don’t mix radio and checkbox rows in one group - a group is either single-choice or multi-choice, never both.
